name: Get attribute groups
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the list of attribute groups and their attributes for a specific object type (e.g., companies). Use a different endpoint if you need to modify or create attribute groups instead.

object_type.description: The object type to retrieve attribute groups for, e.g., "companies".

id.description: Unique identifier of the attribute group.

accountId.description: Identifier of the account owning the attribute group.

groupName.description: Human‑readable name of the attribute group.

component.description: UI component where the group is displayed (e.g., "details").

objectType.description: The object type this group belongs to.

attributes.description: List of attribute keys included in this group.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the group was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the group.
